scripts.dev: npm run dev:citizen & npm run dev:admin
scripts.build:admin: vite build --config vite.admin.config.ts && mv dist-admin/admin.html dist-admin/index.html
scripts.cert: mkdir -p .cert && IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 || hostname -I | cut -d' ' -f1) && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 365 -subj /CN=wardsentry-dev -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1,IP:$IP" -keyout .cert/key.pem -out .cert/cert.pem && echo "Phone URL: https://$IP:5173/citizen"
